scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && python -m alembic upgrade head && python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000 --no-access-log
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run typecheck:backend
scripts.test: npm test -w frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.lint:fix: eslint . --fix && cd backend && python -m ruff check . --fix
scripts.format: prettier --write . && cd backend && python -m ruff format .
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && cd backend && python -m ruff format --check .
